content.intro: আমরা আপনার ব্যক্তিগত তথ্য সুরক্ষিত রাখতে প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ। এই নীতি ব্যাখ্যা করে কিভাবে আমরা তথ্য সংগ্রহ, ব্যবহার এবং সুরক্ষা করি।

sections.heading: Information We Collect
items: Contact information (name, phone, email) through WhatsApp and contact forms
Payment details (bKash, Nagad, Bank Transfer reference) — processed securely
Usage data for analytics (anonymized, no tracking cookies)
Device information for security purposes

sections.heading: How We Use Information
items: Deliver AI tool subscriptions and support services
Process payments and refunds
Send order confirmations and service updates via WhatsApp
Improve our services through anonymized analytics

sections.heading: Data Security
items: We use HTTPS encryption for all data transmission
Payment data is NOT stored on our servers — processed via secure payment gateways
We do NOT use cookies for tracking or advertising
Access to user data is restricted to authorized staff only

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
items: We are not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Canva, or other tool providers
Subscriptions are managed independently — we do not sell data to third parties
WhatsApp and Messenger are used for communication only

sections.heading: Your Rights
items: Request access to your data
Request correction or deletion of your information
Opt-out of non-essential communications
Contact: support@aiteampremium.com or WhatsApp +880-1533-262758

content.intro: এই শর্তাবলী আমাদের সেবা ব্যবহারের নিয়ম নির্ধারণ করে। সেবা ব্যবহার করে আপনি এই শর্তাবলী মেনে চলতে সম্মত হচ্ছেন।

sections.heading: Subscription Terms
items: Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled
Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase
Cancellation via WhatsApp: +880-1533-262758
Shared accounts may have device or usage restrictions

sections.heading: User Responsibilities
items: You agree not to share credentials with unauthorized users
Violating provider terms (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) may result in account ban
Multi-device login on shared accounts may trigger security locks
You assume risk for misuse or unauthorized access

sections.heading: Service Warranty
items: Shared subscriptions: 30-day full warranty if unused or within terms
Personal accounts: Tied to your own account management
Warranty void if: account is banned, shared beyond terms, or credentials are changed
No guarantee of uptime or service continuity

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
items: AI Team Premium is not liable for loss of data or unauthorized access
We are not affiliated with or responsible for tool provider policies
Use subscriptions at your own risk
Maximum refund is the amount paid

sections.heading: Prohibited Activities
items: Reselling subscriptions without permission
Using tools for illegal or harmful purposes
Reverse-engineering or unauthorized access
Circumventing regional restrictions

content.intro: আমরা ৩০ দিনের মধ্যে অব্যবহৃত সাবস্ক্রিপশনের জন্য রিফান্ড প্রদান করি। নিচে বিস্তারিত নীতি পড়ুন।

sections.heading: 30-Day Refund Policy
items: Full refund within 30 days of purchase if unused
Shared account: Refund if subscription has not been accessed
Personal account: Refund if account is still in your control
Refunds processed to original payment method

sections.heading: Refund Ineligible Cases
items: Account banned by tool provider due to policy violation
Login attempted on unauthorized devices (shared accounts)
Account credentials changed or transferred
Refund request after 30-day window
Service used extensively (beyond trial period)

sections.heading: How to Request a Refund
items: WhatsApp: +880-1533-262758 with order details
Email: support@aiteampremium.com
Include: Order date, payment method, reason for refund

sections.heading: Refund Processing Time
items: bKash/Nagad: 2-4 hours
Bank Transfer: 3-5 business days
Refund confirmation sent via WhatsApp

signals.title: Secure Payment
signals.description: Local payment methods (bKash, Nagad) — no international card fees

signals.title: Bangla Support
signals.description: Native Bangla speaker support via WhatsApp and Messenger

signals.title: Honest Pricing
signals.description: No hidden fees. Prices shown include all costs.

signals.title: 30-Day Guarantee
signals.description: Full refund if you're not satisfied

signals.title: Privacy First
signals.description: No tracking cookies. HTTPS encryption on all data.

sections.heading: Shared vs. Personal Accounts
sections.content: Shared accounts cost less কারণ আপনি একটি সাবস্ক্রিপশন অন্যদের সাথে শেয়ার করছেন। Personal accounts বেশি কিন্তু সম্পূর্ণ নিয়ন্ত্রণ দেয়।

sections.heading: What's Included
items: ✓ Full access to tool features
✓ 30-day warranty (if unused/within terms)
✓ Bangla support via WhatsApp
✓ One-time delivery setup fee included

sections.heading: What's NOT Included
items: ✗ Tool provider support (contact them directly)
✗ Account recovery if compromised
✗ Guaranteed uptime
✗ Resale rights

sections.heading: When Prices Change
sections.content: আমরা প্রতি মাসের শেষে pricing review করি। Tool providers তাদের USD মূল্য পরিবর্তন করলে আমাদের BDT মূল্যও পরিবর্তন হতে পারে। আপনার নবায়নের আগে নতুন মূল্য নিশ্চিত করা হবে।
